name: fe-failsafe
summary: After a front-end mailbox transaction has timed out (10 s), the next ones wait at most 500 ms per phase until one completes again: keys and OSD keep working while the front-end does not answer; RAM 0x2024E0 = 1 while active, 0x2024E1 = number of timed-out transactions
